Container.Name: SubtitleSync
Container.Overview: Local subtitle synchronization and Whisper.cpp speech to text in a browser desktop. CPU, AMD/Intel GPU and integrated APU via Vulkan, NVIDIA via CUDA or Vulkan. Import the locally built image before adding this template. Host GPU drivers are required. For AMD/Intel add --device=/dev/dri:/dev/dri to Extra Parameters. For NVIDIA install the Unraid NVIDIA Driver plugin, add --gpus=all to Extra Parameters, and select the GPU UUID in NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES. Retain --shm-size=1g. Do not expose the Web UI to the Internet.

Config.Name: Web UI
Config.Description: Browser desktop. Trusted LAN only; use an authenticated TLS reverse proxy for remote access.

Config.Name: Settings and models
Config.Description: Persistent settings, models and downloaded GPU/speech runtimes.

Config.Name: Media and subtitles
Config.Description: Video/subtitle input and generated output. Only expose the folders the app needs.

Config.Name: NVIDIA devices
Config.Description: GPU UUID or all. Requires NVIDIA Driver plugin and --gpus=all in Extra Parameters.

Config.Name: NVIDIA capabilities
Config.Description: CUDA, nvidia-smi and Vulkan userspace driver injection.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: Unraid nobody; change to match media ownership if needed.

Config.Name: Supplementary groups
Config.Description: Optional comma-separated additional numeric group IDs. Standard non-root DRI device groups are detected by the desktop base.

Config.Name: Desktop password
Config.Description: Optional desktop password (maximum 8 characters); not a replacement for TLS and network isolation.
